primary_assessments.inspected: Full JATS XML and publisher PDF; Tables 1-3, Figures 1-4; full 12-page supplement text and relevant pixels S3,S4,S6-S9,S11. PDF12 is blank. Main and supplement are one study, not independent experiments.
primary_assessments.material: Element root distinct from RuCl3.2H2O feed, oxide/hydroxide mixtures, Pd-seeded catalyst and biomass.
primary_assessments.organism: Paper Bacillus benzeovorans NCIMB 12555 maps via exact collection identifier to NCBI 1456 Bacillus benzoevorans species. No strain-level taxon falsely asserted.
primary_assessments.interpretation: Other process denotes observed deposition on microbial biomass without resolved causal pathway. No Ru(0) or metallic PdRu alloy; XPS III/VI versus XANES III/IV and air handling prevent uniform valence. Table 3 fitted Ru-Ru shell conflicts with prose absence claim; S6 high-loading label differs from Table 1.
primary_assessments.controls: No-metal microscopy baseline; matched no-cell/killed-cell/hydrogen-free Ru outcomes and assay replication unspecified. Acidic exposure and dry processing preclude assuming sustained viability.
primary_assessments.quantitation: Loadings inferred from solution difference, not isolated yield; ~40% residual prose not exact for every Table 1 ratio. No native concentration observations imported.

primary_assessments.decision: curate distinct monometallic and simultaneous mixed-feed Rh assays
primary_assessments.identity: Electronic publication 2025-12-16; collection 2026-02-03, journal volume8 pages961-972. Current XML identifies PMC version .2; issue metadata is not a new experiment or evidence of a formal correction.
primary_assessments.inspected: Full JATS XML; original Figure 1-6 JPEGs inspected; Tables1-2; complete two-page supplementaryTableS1 PDF parsed and table page rendered. Publisher PDF attempts403; complete evidence available via open EuropePMC archive.
primary_assessments.material: RhCl3.xH2O stock; 200 micromolar single feed versus 100 micromolar Rh plus 100 micromolar Pd simultaneous feed. No sequential seeding or real waste stream.
primary_assessments.organism: Geobacter sulfurreducens species 35554; strain accession not stated and not inferred from type strain or cited media.
primary_assessments.controls: Single-metal cell-free Rh shows no comparable depletion; mixed no-cell system loses about 20% Rh. Methods donor-free control mentioned without Rh-specific outcomes. Figure 1 error bars and replicate count undefined. No viability/killed-cell/enzyme causality established.
primary_assessments.interpretation: Rh0 phase in monometallic harvested material supported by XRD/SAED, without resolved Rh XPS or complete reduced fraction. Mixed PdRh alloy interpretation integrates XRD/HRTEM/EDS; method-specific composition estimates differ.81/19 XPS percentages are fitted surface proportions.
primary_assessments.quantitation: Centrifuged-supernatant ICPMS depletion versus isolated metal yield; catalytic 4-NP conversion is separate. No exact mg/kg cells with source dates; no native observations imported.
